notes: Focused IEEE 1516.2-2025 §6.2.20 public-API witness for the Variant Record Name rule at p. 95 l. 46. Public Create accepts the valid control; the schema-valid negative differs only by a period in the Variant Record Name and must be rejected as InconsistentFOM. This demonstrates the period restriction only, not every HLA naming rule, other variant-record fields, arbitrary FOMs, or conformance.
